text:
I understand you need an Android developer for a small task on your existing Android app, whether that means minor adjustments, bug fixes, or adding a small feature.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience working with Python, machine learning, and NLP tools such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas. While my background is mainly in AI and data-focused development, I’m comfortable working carefully through technical details and collaborating to resolve small implementation issues efficiently.

If you share the task details, I can review the requirements and let you know the best way to move forward. I’m happy to help with clear communication and a focused approach to get the job done smoothly.
